app.title: Mosaic Studio
app.tagline: Cut pieces, then lay your mosaic.

file.confirmNew: Start a new mosaic? Unsaved changes will be lost.

library.title: Pieces
library.placedCount: {count, plural, =0 {not placed} one {placed once} other {placed # times}}
library.empty: No pieces yet. Make one with “New piece”.
library.confirmDelete: Delete “{name}”? It is placed {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}} on the workboard, and those copies go too.

editor.title: Piece
editor.lockedTitle: This piece is on the workboard
editor.lockedBody: Pieces can't change once placed. Use “Duplicate as new” to make an editable variant.
editor.noPiece: Select or make a piece to edit it.

workboard.trayHint: Drag a piece onto the board, or click it to place it in the middle.
workboard.trayEmpty: Make pieces on the cutboard first.
workboard.selection: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {1 piece selected} other {# pieces selected}}
workboard.emptyBoard: Your mosaic grows from the pieces you place: there is no fixed canvas size.
workboard.help: Drag empty table to pan · wheel or pinch to zoom · while dragging a piece, wheel or a second finger turns it
workboard.lockedNotice: That piece is locked. Unlock it to move it.
workboard.keys: Keys: Delete removes · L locks or unlocks · R turns 15° (Shift: back) · [ ] move back or forward (Shift: to the end) · Esc clears the selection

errors.piece-placed: That piece is on the workboard and can't be changed.
errors.placement-missing: That placed piece no longer exists.
errors.placement-locked: That piece is locked. Unlock it first.
errors.outline-too-few-points: That cut is too short to make a piece. Draw a closed outline.
errors.outline-too-small: That piece would be too small. Draw a larger outline.
errors.outline-splits: That outline crosses itself into separate pieces. Draw it as one loop.
errors.outline-not-simple: That outline crosses itself. Draw it as one loop.

cut.hint: Draw the outline in one stroke. Wheel or two fingers move the view; Esc cancels.
